name: Mid America Wire & Cable
old_description: Since 2007, Mid America Wire & Cable has been the trusted distributor for contractors, OEMs, utilities, and industrial buyers across the United States. We pair deep technical expertise with an extensive in-stock inventory so you can specify, quote, and receive the right product fast.
about:
Mid America Wire & Cable was founded in 2007 in Tulsa, Oklahoma. The company operates as a wholesale distributor of wire and cable products, serving contractors, original equipment manufacturers, utilities, and industrial buyers across the United States.

The distributor stocks thousands of part numbers across categories that include automotive wire, building wire, hook-up wire, industrial automation and control cable, mil-spec wire, power cable and portable cord, shipboard and marine cable, and transit and locomotive cable. It offers aluminum and copper service entrance capabilities and provides custom and standard part sourcing with same-day shipping on in-stock items. The company operates a nationwide distribution network covering all 50 states.

Mid America Wire & Cable supplies industries such as construction, automotive, telecommunications, electrical, aerospace, healthcare, manufacturing, consumer electronics, renewable energy, and marine. Its customer base includes electrical contractors, OEMs, utility companies, and industrial maintenance departments.

The company emphasizes deep technical expertise paired with an extensive in-stock inventory to help customers specify, quote, and receive the right product quickly. Its differentiation rests on same-day fulfillment, broad product availability, and technical support for product selection.
